span.p:
Unknown is a durable nonterminal state.
A timeout or one empty lookup is not proof of rejection.
Operator review is required when reconciliation cannot resolve it.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Canceled orders can have nonzero filled quantity.
Fill facts remain reconcilable after order termination.
Terminal state never deletes execution history.
